build_model_from_zoo: build a DynamicStereoModel or RAFTStereoModel instance by calling model_zoo with the model name string
build_model_with_kwargs: build a stereo model from the model zoo passing keyword arguments for model-specific configuration
get_default_configs: get a deep copy of all registered model default configurations via get_all_model_default_configs
review_model_zoo_factory: review the model_zoo factory function that resolves model class by name and instantiates with kwargs
review_MODEL_NAME_TO_MODEL: review the _MODEL_NAME_TO_MODEL registry dict that maps model class names to their classes
